requirement.normalizedRequirement: IF sewage_discharge_type = comminuted_and_disinfected, THEN MARPOL_IV_11_1_1_compliance_status = compliant AND distance_to_nearest_ice_shelf_or_fast_ice_nm > 3; record distance from areas with ice_concentration_tenths > 1.
requirement.requiredInputs: Discharge type, MARPOL compliance, position, and ice-condition data
requirement.source: International Code for Ships Operating in Polar Waters (Polar Code)
requirement.sourceText: The ship is discharging comminuted and disinfected sewage in accordance with regulation 11.1.1 of MARPOL Annex IV at a distance of more than three nautical miles from any ice-shelf or fast ice and shall be as far as practicable from areas of ice concentration exceeding 1/10.
